# §2 · #4 — Complex Dynamism

<!-- reader-navigation -->
Movement 23 of 48 · [This room](../ROOM.md) · [← Previous](22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia.md) · [Next →](24-s2-p5-zero-changes-role.md)
<!-- /reader-navigation -->

## Movement thesis

The two logics can be read dynamically as one alternating pulse. Dia-ballein bifurcates a field and makes a trajectory actual; sym-ballein recursively composes differentiated trajectories into a provisional basin; perturbation can open that basin to further difference. Symmetry breaking and symmetry making alternate as operations in the metabolism of complex form.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md|John R. Van Eenwyk]] gives the Jungian bridge. Complexes and archetypal patterns can be compared with attractors: trajectories are drawn into characteristic forms while remaining sensitive to initial conditions and basin boundaries. Individuation becomes especially legible near those boundaries, where an established pattern is coherent enough to persist and encounter can nevertheless reorganise what future trajectories are available. The comparison remains psychological/dynamical rather than an identity between an archetype and a mathematical attractor.

## Warrant and necessary remainder

In this register the gap appears as fluctuation, non-closure, sensitive boundary, unoccupied phase-space, and the remainder through which novelty can enter. These dynamical conditions prevent a complex system from being adequately described as a frozen identity; an operationally closed unity can still be structurally coupled and perturbed. Gödelian incompleteness concerns a different formal object, and the relation between them is structural rather than identical.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition.md|Maturana and Varela]] supply the biological counterpoint: operational closure and structural coupling distinguish a living unity from both isolation and mere external assembly. The essay's further formulation—"No boundary, no agent. No remainder, no learning"—is an argued QL extension, not their conclusion.

The pulse belongs to a wider process line. Bergsonian duration makes the present carry its differentiating past; [[symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md|Whiteheadian concrescence]] gathers inherited many into a new one that becomes data for later occasions; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity|Gebserian mutation]] makes structures transparent to their co-presence rather than discarding them. QL gives this family an operative grammar: dia breaks symmetry and actualises a branch; sym composes, contextualises, and returns; `5→0` makes the achieved form a renewed condition rather than a terminal object.

[[symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm|Bohm]] distinguishes analysis from fragmentation. Analysis explicates a relatively stable form so its behaviour can be known. Fragmentation occurs when the analytic divisions are attributed to the whole as final separations and internal relatedness disappears. Dia-ballein is the necessary explicating cut; sym-ballein is the retention of implication through the cut. Atomisation is the runtime arrested between them.

## Basin and paradigm

The R3 paradigm relation gives the dynamical comparison a precise limit and a useful office. A basin or attractor landscape is **not** a paradigm, but it can model one aspect of paradigmatic stability: a structured field in which some trajectories become easy, recurrent or intelligible while others become difficult, unstable or unavailable. Ordinary adaptation can move skilfully within such a landscape without changing the landscape itself.

That distinction matters because **paradigm change is closer to a transformation of the regime that organises trajectories than to another successful trajectory inside the same basin**. A perturbation that is absorbed without changing the operative constraints is not yet paradigmatic reflexivity. A returned difference becomes paradigm-relevant when it can alter the conditions by which subsequent differences are selected, valued or channelled. The comparison remains Offered/Argued at the structural level; no psychological paradigm is thereby identified with a mathematical basin.

This gives the later distinction between adaptation and cultivation a dynamical prehistory. A system can become highly adaptive while its governing attractor landscape grows more rigid. Epistemic cultivation will require the stronger capacity for encounters to expose and sometimes transform the conditions of adaptation themselves.

The political psychic cycle has the same dynamic shape. Atomisation and loss of meaningful relation leave affect unbound; a single narrative can bind that affect by intensifying one branch and converting the excluded branch into the cause of the field's pain. The resolution is real as affect but false as ground: the local determination has occupied `0`. Divine and concur reopens the basin—not by dissolving conflict, but by restoring the relational field in which differentiated parties can become mutually answerable. The institutional question remains irreducible: no psychic account is adequate unless it asks [how offices, media, property, and coercion stabilise or interrupt the cycle](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/technology-politics/DEVELOPMENT.md#formation-and-enframing).

## Apollo–Dionysus safeguard

Apollo makes the `1` visible through measure, boundary, and form. Dionysus returns fixed form to participatory life. Apollo without Dionysian depth petrifies what it illuminates; Dionysus without Apollonian articulation dissolves the differences through which relation lives. Gebserian diaphaneity is their mature conjunction in the essay's reading: form transparent to origin, life capable of returning as form.

The [myth historical development](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/encounters-and-transmissions/myth/DEVELOPMENT.md#4--aesthetic-reciprocity-becomes-a-perspective-capable-of-return) **historicises** the Apollo–Dionysus safeguard through Nietzsche’s aesthetic reciprocity and Taylor’s distinct Gebserian return. The source histories preserve articulation and participation without supplying a dynamical model’s empirical proof.

## Transition

[E2’s arbitration in crisis](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) gives this movement its relational test for a change of regime: [Con-text exposes the conditions under which arbitration has operated](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity), and [Resolution lets consequence revise them](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation). The distinction between movement within a basin and transformation of its governing regime is now the exact bridge to paradigm: one changes a state; the other can change the field by which states acquire their trajectories.

The complex-dynamical pulse shows why the two accountings cannot remain merely philosophical. Once the relation includes its own differentiation, two expands into the sixfold generative unit in [[24-s2-p5-zero-changes-role|§2 · #5→0 — Zero Changes Its Role]].

The [authored P1 route for M23](../P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT.md#p1-m23) **grounds** this movement’s canonical A/C alignment within the phase bounds and dispositions stated there.
